unit.title: The suit coat sleeve
unit.needIt: Knowing how to shape a sleeve helps you fix a suit that feels stiff or awkward. It lets you make clothes that move naturally with your body instead of feeling like a costume.
unit.why: A suit sleeve needs to look sharp but still let your arm move freely. The author explains how to add a tiny bit of extra fabric at the elbow to create a natural curve. This small trick makes a stiff coat feel comfortable and look professional.
unit.outcome: Construct a tailored coat sleeve with proper shape and balance.
unit.reachesYou: You see this when you notice a suit jacket sleeve looks flat or bunchy at the elbow. You also see it when you try to move your arm and the fabric feels too tight.
unit.do: Find a jacket you own and look at the elbow area. See if the fabric folds naturally or if it looks flat and stiff.

quiz.q: What is a requirement for a tailored suit sleeve compared to a sport coat sleeve?
quiz.why: The text states that a tailored suit sleeve must be closer fitting than a sport coat sleeve.
quiz.quote: The sleeve for a Tailored suit must of necessity be closer fitting than the fuller Sport Coat or Top Coat Sleeve.

quiz.q: How much longer should the under sleeve be than the upper sleeve?
quiz.why: The instructions specify a half inch difference for the under sleeve.
quiz.quote: It must also be remembered that the under sleeve must be one-half inch longer than the upper sleeve

quiz.q: Why is fullness added between the top and the elbow?
choices: To make it easier to sew
quiz.why: The fullness is necessary to shape the sleeve and make it hang properly.
quiz.quote: This fullness is necessary to shape the sleeve and make it hang properly.

quiz.q: What should you do when sewing the front seam on a machine?
quiz.why: The text warns to stitch the seam so that no gathers will appear.
quiz.quote: When sewing the front seam, and especially if you are using a sewing machine, stitch the seam so that no gathers will appear.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of the canvas in the sleeve?
quiz.why: The canvas is tacked to the inside seam to prevent it from working down.
quiz.quote: the canvas is tacked to the inside seam to prevent it from working down after the sleeve is finished.

quiz.q: How should you handle the lining when putting it into the sleeve?
quiz.why: The lining should be a trifle smaller than the outside.
quiz.quote: as it is necessary to have the lining a trifle smaller than the outside.

crystal.key: A tailored sleeve needs specific balance and shaping to move naturally.

decoys.text: The lining should be the exact same size as the outside.

decoys.text: The sleeve should be as full as a sport coat.
decoys.why: The text says a tailored sleeve must be closer fitting than a sport coat.

crystal.aha: By balancing straight lines with specific fullness at the elbow, the sleeve achieves both shape and movement.
